summary.zh-CN: 按方法、结果、讨论分开报告自己采集或指定的数据，适合实验课作业。
summary.en: Reports self-collected or assigned data with methods, results and discussion kept apart; suited to lab coursework.

whenToUse.zh-CN: 有实验、测量或调查得到的原始数据
whenToUse.en: There is raw data from an experiment, measurement or survey

whenToUse.zh-CN: 要求写明实验过程以便复现
老师要求按报告格式提交

focus.zh-CN: 说明实验目的与相关背景，给出假设及其依据，写清自变量与因变量的关系；背景只写与本次实验相关的内容。
focus.en: State the purpose and relevant background, then the hypothesis and its basis, including how the variables relate.

focus.zh-CN: 说明这次实验要回答什么、与课程哪个问题相关；背景只保留理解实验所必需的部分。
focus.en: Say what the experiment answers and which course question it belongs to; keep only the background needed to follow it.

focus.zh-CN: 给出可检验的假设，写清自变量、因变量与需要控制的变量；假设要能被打败。
focus.en: State a testable hypothesis with the independent, dependent and controlled variables; it must be capable of failing.

focus.zh-CN: 按时间顺序交代材料、步骤、对照与分析方式，使他人可以复现；不写原理推导与结果。
focus.en: Describe materials, procedure, controls and analysis in chronological order so it can be reproduced; no results here.

focus.zh-CN: 列出材料、仪器型号与关键参数；参数要写到他人能据以复现，不写「若干」「适量」。
focus.en: List materials, instrument models and key parameters precisely enough to reproduce; avoid 'some' or 'an appropriate amount'.

focus.zh-CN: 按实际顺序写步骤与对照设置，说明每组重复次数；与实验记录一致，不补做没做过的步骤。
focus.en: Write the steps and controls in the order performed, with the number of repeats per group; match the lab record and invent nothing.

focus.zh-CN: 说明数据如何整理、用哪种统计或计算方法、显著性水平取多少；方法写在得到结果之前。
focus.en: Say how the data is processed, which statistical or computational method is used and at what significance level; decide this before seeing results.

focus.zh-CN: 如实报告观测与计算得到的数值，用表格呈现精确数据、用图呈现趋势；只呈现不解释，图表编号、题注并注明单位。
focus.en: Report observed and computed values factually; tables for precision, figures for trends, numbered with units. No interpretation.

focus.zh-CN: 用两三句概括结果的整体样子，再引出分项数据；不在此下结论。
focus.en: Summarise the overall pattern in two or three sentences before the detail; draw no conclusion here.

focus.zh-CN: 逐项给出数值，表格呈现精确数据、图呈现趋势；图表按「表 3-1」「图 3-1」编号并配题注，单位写全。
focus.en: Give the values item by item, tables for precision and figures for trends; number them as Table 3-1 and Figure 3-1 with captions and full units.

focus.zh-CN: 报告偏离趋势的数据点与仪器误差范围，说明是保留还是剔除及理由；不静默删掉不利数据。
focus.en: Report points that depart from the trend and the instrument error range, and say whether they were kept or dropped and why; never silently discard inconvenient data.

focus.zh-CN: 说明数据是否支持假设，分析误差来源（不写空泛的「人为误差」），与既有研究比较，并说明本次实验的限制。
focus.en: State whether the data supports the hypothesis, analyse error sources concretely, compare with existing work and state limitations.

title.en: Does the Data Support the Hypothesis

focus.zh-CN: 对照假设逐条判断支持、部分支持或不支持，并指出依据是哪个数据；不支持就说不支持。
focus.en: Judge each hypothesis as supported, partly supported or not, pointing at the data that decides it; say so when it is not supported.

focus.zh-CN: 分析误差的具体来源与量级，说明哪一项最可能影响结论；不写空泛的「人为误差」。
focus.en: Analyse the concrete sources and magnitudes of error and which one most affects the conclusion; avoid the empty phrase 'human error'.

focus.zh-CN: 把结果与文献或他人实验对比，说明一致或不一致及可能原因；只比有出处的数据。
focus.en: Compare the result with published or peer data, explaining agreement or disagreement and its likely cause; compare only against sourced numbers.

focus.zh-CN: 说明样本、条件或方法上的限制，以及结论因此能被推到多远；限制要具体到本次实验。
focus.en: State the limits in sample, conditions or method and how far the conclusion may be pushed; be specific to this experiment.

focus.zh-CN: 概括已被数据支持的发现即可，通常很短；不重复讨论中的推测。
focus.en: Summarise only what the data supports; usually brief, without repeating speculation from the discussion.

description.zh-CN: 摘要（目的、方法、主要结果与结论）
description.en: Abstract: purpose, method, main result and conclusion

methodNotes.zh-CN: 没有实际数据时，结果与讨论按待补处理，不编造数值或实验现象。摘要与关键词老师没要求时，可在向导第三步取消勾选。
methodNotes.en: Without real data, results and discussion stay marked as pending; never invent values or observations. Untick the abstract and keywords in step three of the wizard if the assignment does not ask for them.
